name: list_tasks
description: List all tasks from CatPilot storage, filtered by status. Each task includes its SMART fields, SMART score and computed Eisenhower quadrant.

quadrant.description: Only return tasks in this Eisenhower quadrant (optional)

name: add_task
description: Add a new task to CatPilot

goal.description: SMART · Specific — what "done" concretely looks like (optional)

measure.description: SMART · Measurable — how success will be verified (optional)

steps.description: SMART · Achievable — the first concrete steps (optional)

why.description: SMART · Relevant — why this matters now (optional)

importance.description: Eisenhower importance. Omit or 'auto' to let CatPilot derive it (optional)

urgency.description: Eisenhower urgency. Omit or 'auto' to let CatPilot derive it (optional)

name: set_task_smart
description: Set or clear the SMART fields (goal, measure, steps, why) and the Eisenhower importance/urgency axes on an existing task. Only the provided fields change; pass an empty string to clear one.

goal.description: SMART · Specific — what "done" concretely looks like

measure.description: SMART · Measurable — how success will be verified

steps.description: SMART · Achievable — the first concrete steps

why.description: SMART · Relevant — why this matters now

due.description: SMART · Time-bound — due date in YYYY-MM-DD format

name: task_matrix
description: Return tasks organised into the Eisenhower Matrix (Q1 urgent+important, Q2 important, Q3 urgent, Q4 neither), grouped by Overdue / Today / Next 7 days / Later / No date / Completed, plus coaching insights about the balance.

name: task_focus
description: Return a ranked 'what should I do next' list built from the Eisenhower Matrix, with a one-line reason per task and coaching insights.

name: task_carry
description: Move open tasks that are still filed under an earlier period (month/week/day) into the current one. Use this when list_tasks reports a 'stranded' summary, or the user asks where their tasks went after a period rolled over. Completed tasks stay where they were finished.

dryRun.description: Preview what would move without writing anything

ids.description: Only carry these task IDs (default: all open stranded tasks)

name: add_journal_entry
description: Add a journal entry for today
